lessons.title: Lesson 1: Vocabulary & Pronunciation /br/, /kr/, /tr/
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Vocabulary & Pronunciation /br/, /kr/, /tr/.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Present Simple expresses habits, routines and permanent facts (always, usually, every day). Present Continuous expresses actions happening at the moment of speaking or temporary situations (now, at present, look!).
concepts.example: My father usually cooks dinner, but today he is working late, so my mother is cooking.
concepts.essence: The contrast between routine stability (Simple) and temporary ongoing activity (Continuous).

rules.meaning: Verbs expressing states, feelings, senses or possession (know, like, love, understand, believe, want) are normally NOT used in continuous forms.
rules.example: I understand the lesson now (NOT: I am understanding).
rules.essence: These verbs describe permanent inner mental/emotional states rather than physical dynamic actions.

workedExamples.prompt: Complete with the correct form of verbs: 'Be quiet! The baby (sleep) in the bedroom. She usually (sleep) for two hours in the afternoon.'
steps: Step 1: 'Be quiet!' indicates an ongoing action right now => use Present Continuous: is sleeping.
Step 2: 'She usually' indicates a daily habit => use Present Simple: sleeps.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using 'am knowing' or 'am wanting' with stative verbs.
commonMistakes.why: Stative verbs do not describe physical actions and take simple tenses even with time markers like 'now'.
